answer.book: A single Latin dissertation (1622) by Caspar Waser, printed in Zurich: a title page, a dedicatory letter to Daniel Studer that runs on as the whole disputation of about 7,600 words, then FINIS and two appended quotations from Theodoretus and Tertullian.

entries.title: Nobilissimo viro Dn. Danieli Studero, Patritio Sancti Galli, &c. fautori suo honorando S. D. Caspar Vvaservs.
